newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, week's first deal not yet don.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, week's first deal not yet don.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract was untraded again on Tuesday morning.
It has yet to trade its first deal of the week.

The market sentiment was slightly bearish in the front months, with July and August both offered at or near the previous settlement level by the close of the morning session while bids were lower. But in most other periods bids and offers were wider apart, straddling the previous settlement level.
July was bid at 9.85 pence a therm against an offer at 9.95 pence by the close, with August in the range 9.80/9.95 pence.
